kind: published ISS infrastructure precedent; not our capsule specification
name: NASA EXPRESS Rack
location: EXPRESS Rack Resources table, printed page 13
inference: Shared interfaces do not mean every position can operate at its individual maximum simultaneously. This power-only bound ignores further cooling and integration limits.
boundary: ISS rack services depend on station infrastructure and crew support. They do not establish the mass, power, thermal design or autonomy of a free-flying foundry capsule.

specialized_precedent.name: Materials Science Research Rack
specialized_precedent.observation: NASA describes shared support services feeding a materials laboratory with interchangeable furnace inserts. This supports modular infrastructure with specialized process hardware.
